- Initial invite: 10 days before session window opens (Tuesday 9am local)
- Reminder 1: 5 days before (short, highlight speaker + quick agenda)
- Reminder 2: 24 hours before (CTA: add to calendar + join office hours)
- Final/Last-chance: 1 hour before (short link + dial-in)

- Can Marissa own final invite copy and subject-line tests?
- Connor, can you confirm preferred send windows for automated segmentation in our ESP (we want TZ-aware sends)?

If the above works, we'll turn around a signed shared landing page spec and final cohost creative. I'm free for a 20-min sync Thu morning.

Thanks,
